title: Birds Are Getting Caught In The Chemtrails
text: We're talking about how the chemtrails kill the birds. Ducks flying at 10,000 ft will match a chemtrail plane flying at 10,000 ft. So, simplifying it a little bit, birds fly high, chemtrail planes fly low, birds get caught into the chemtrails themselves and get snuffed out and then die. And we're not just talking about a few birds. We're talking about thousands of birds. tens of thousands in just a flock migrating. We're talking about a massive amount of birds dying close to death almost at exactly the same time. And keep in mind, every batch lot in the plane, every group of chemicals that they have that they're dumping, whether it's geoengineering planes or a chemtrail plane, can be different at any given time. So, some concoctions could be instantly deadly, while some are intoxicating and dangerous enough to weaken the birds, causing their flight pattern to be disturbed, causing them to weaken and have to drop out of the sky, disturbing the process of nature, destroying the very birds we love. So, how do 10,000 birds die at a clip? How does it really happen? [Music]
